verdict.rationale: The published trademark pages put an account wall in front of the core filing flow: users must create a USPTO.gov account with MFA and verify their identity before they can access TEAS or Trademark Center. The only keyless path documented is a form preview, which is an adjacent feature, not starting the core flow. The Patent Center note that only registered users can view or track submissions implies, but does not document, an unregistered filing path. No file-number entry path is documented.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
